geometrySource.meaning: Exact saved geometry/overlap flags reused after pinned native geometry and face-order validation; no saved water values reused.

limits: Synthetic design storm, not current conditions. Exact original design rainfall and record-river curve transplanted by elapsed simulation time onto each wider case; its original antecedent and other inlet flows remain unchanged. The absolute scenario clock shifts by five hours. Return period describes the imposed rainfall, not a calibrated joint flood probability. No river hydrograph is invented for model areas without the Santa Cruz inlet.

forcing.meaning: Prescribed synthetic scenario inputs, not observed or current conditions. Frame values interpolate supplied samples for display only; null means unavailable, never zero.

northern.spatialMeaning: Uniform prescribed rainfall over this native model domain. Bounds enclose the domain and are not a separate measured rainfall footprint.

picture-rocks.spatialMeaning: Uniform prescribed rainfall over this native model domain. Bounds enclose the domain and are not a separate measured rainfall footprint.

gates.spatialMeaning: Uniform prescribed rainfall over this native model domain. Bounds enclose the domain and are not a separate measured rainfall footprint.

inflow.meaning: Santa Cruz design inlet only, not the sum of all inlets or overlapping model areas.

picture-rocks.unavailableReason: This model area has no Santa Cruz design-storm inlet; its other inlet flows remain unchanged.

gates.unavailableReason: This model area has no Santa Cruz design-storm inlet; its other inlet flows remain unchanged.

unknownValues: JSON null and FPQW route NaN mean unavailable. Negative native residuals remain raw in route-points.json and native source; they are unknown for display. Unknown cells, and web blocks containing them, are omitted from water painting and encoded separately; consumers must return null, not dry, for those indices.
displayDepth: Finite nonnegative native volume / full native area; web blocks preserve total volume over complete 50 m squares. Sparse display lists depths >= 0.005 m in rounded mm; route values retain float32 precision. Depths above 65.535 m are capped only in the sparse mm display.
